issue.title: Counted same-note Depends-On add fails to plan when the prerequisite sits above the sources and BLOCKS mirroring is on

task_type_fields.impact: N<Ctrl+Shift+B> on several tasks below a same-note prerequisite refuses and writes nothing under the default blocks_lines setting; counted vault paths can stamp [fresh::] on the wrong line.
task_type_fields.repro: planCountedLocalTaskDependency with Target above two same-note sources and blocksLinesEnabled: true returns valid:false ("Could not plan dependency navigation for every source task"); the same call with blocksLinesEnabled: false links both sources. Script is in the description.

issue.creation_reason: Found while verifying the keep-cursor plan's stale-line-index fix: the counted writers still assume a source's snapshot line survives earlier plans, which BLOCKS-line insertion above breaks.

payload.description: Batch 6 successor planning by bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 lander: rank candidate

payload.entry: Evidence for blocks-shift fix: counted planners now map every tracked source through plan.lineEdits (270 pure planner, 420 remove + vault loops) with parentLineNext stamping and mapped cursorLine; writer maps cursor through Pomodoro cleanup. Baseline fixture now plans valid:true with both sources, reverse BLOCKS row lists both, cursor on First (line2) not BLOCKS. Covered by hotkeys-dependencies + stage-stale-guards vault tests (same-note add/remove, cross-note control, one undo). Plugin 2.56.3 deployed and synced; leaving open for parent lander.
